title: A finished detached gate delivers an actionable sign-off: what finished, verdict, next owner and exact next action
outcome: A finished detached gate delivers an actionable sign-off: what finished, verdict, next owner and exact next action
acceptance: The launcher's completion message (stdout summary and --notify delivery) is metadata-only and carries: run id, what finished (item, stage counts), verdict with input-fingerprint result, the owner of the next transition and the exact next action, both supplied at launch and echoed unchanged; tests cover pass, fail, interrupted and fingerprint-mismatch, and that no log text is injected

Delivery goes to the coordinator and the launching holder through the existing notification route, with an immutable body and a stable idempotency key; no polling, watchdog, timer, daemon or new telemetry is added

The host/client contract for showing an active detached runner apart from an idle agent, with the pending next transition, is agreed with TermAl's coordinator and recorded in a holder note quoting TermAl's item reference

completion.summary: Detached gates deliver metadata-only sign-offs with exact launch-supplied item, next owner and next action; admitted metadata and notification targets frozen for recovery/retry, safe failure locators retained, and TermAl host contract recorded. Full gate passed, Codex/Claude pair noMedium+, independent acceptance3/3. Committed, installed and pushed master.
